name: European gas (TTF)
summary: European gas near €90/MWh on 13 Nov, up 8.5% on the week and above the €70 Alert line; Hormuz LNG route restricted
state: Dutch TTF gas closed near €90/MWh on 13 Nov, 8.5% higher on the week and 41% higher over three months, 14% below its 52-week high of €104 and well above the €70 Alert line (Yahoo Finance). Qatari LNG relies on the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran's Revolutionary Guards claimed further mine strikes on tankers on 15 Nov (Anadolu Agency).
for_you: High wholesale gas prices tend to feed through to household energy bills and business costs over the following months; Ofgem sets the GB price cap quarterly.

sources.title: Yahoo Finance — Dutch TTF gas futures

why: European gas sets UK and EU power prices and heating bills; Europe has had no cushion since losing Russian pipeline gas.
drivers: LNG supply, storage levels, weather, Norwegian outages, Middle East LNG routes.

rubric.alert: TTF > €70/MWh, or a major supply cut-off (e.g. Qatar LNG or Norway outage > 1 week).
rubric.watch: TTF €40–70/MWh, or storage > 10 points below seasonal norm.
rubric.normal: TTF < €40/MWh and EU storage at or above seasonal norm.
